_comment: Awin shops of Home Gear World for the shared import and the Hub's shadow catalogue (31 Oct 2026, phase 4 of 'every product through the Hub'). The general rules are in sites/_shared/home-garden-rules.js; a shop here can set: allowPaths (only these sections, lessons L65, taken from the sections of the products the site showed on 31 Oct 2026), sectionHints (false, or the top sections whose names may place a product), gardenShop (every product of the shop is for the garden: Mint Outdoor, Lights4fun, Tooled Up's garden sections), defaultCategory (a shop whose names do not say the type: tado, Beyond Shakers). The older per-shop import rules (tools/import-rules/) still load this site until the shared import replaces them.
